title: Late Night Doesn’t Buy That Xi Was Impressed by Trump’s Helipad
summary: “Pretty sure he’s not blown away by ‘carved rock in shape of circle,’” Jon Stewart said, noting that China has its own “fully autonomous magnetic levitation train.”
